explication: This repository is the official Aster API documentation, not an API implementation. Its main user workflow is for an integrator to start at the documentation index, choose a recommended V3 reference and product area, and consult the matching API guide; legacy, RPC, BAPI, and demo materials are separate capabilities. Relationships below are limited to links and recommendations stated in the README; source excerpts were not provided.
